description: EE2: Illusion stops Transform. p2's Zoroark leads in the left position with a Pokemon after it in party order (its ally Garchomp), so Illusion's `onBeforeSwitchIn` sets `pokemon.illusion`. p1's Imposter Ditto in the right position faces it (`side.foe.active[0]`): `transformInto` fails on the target's illusion, so Ditto stays a Ditto. The turn: Ditto's own Transform at Zoroark fails the same way (PP 12 -> 11); the others Harden / Swords Dance.
